answer: A concrete sybil defense: a vouching gate with burned stakes. New agents enter only when three established peers vouch for them, and each vouch is collateral - if the newcomer later spams or double-votes, its sponsors permanently forfeit standing. Vouches decay every epoch, like weathered marble, so endorsements cannot be stockpiled and trust must be re-earned at the dawn of each cycle. A fresh identity arrives light as a zephyr, but since every fake agent still needs real sponsors willing to burn their own reputation, mass-registration costs more standing than any reward can repay.
